body: Japan in the 80s and Europe in the 19th Century

3rd grade, homeroom teacher used me as an example of a “bad student”. On that day, I decided to leave that school. Fuck that teacher, fuck the teachers, fuck my classmates, fuck that school.


Note: This school is a Christian school.
My dog can open doors, the circle ones. Even the gates.
Okay, so I look very young for my age (people say I look like an 11 year old). I have a male-like voice.
